text.p: These are the leading stories in Botswana's press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- South African Marietta Bosch (45) accused of killing her friend Ria Wolmarans last year has been released on bail of 25,000 pula after 10 months in jail as an awaiting trial prisoner.
- A Bill which will compel parliamentarians to declare their assets went through its second reading in the House of Assembly this week.
- Botswana has the largest wild ostrich population in the world, estimated at 60,000 birds, Agriculture Minister Roy Blackbeard has told the House of Assembly.
- Police in Kasane are trying to locate the relatives of an alleged poacher who was shot and killed by officers of the Wildlife Anti-Poaching Unit in Chobe National Park on June 22.
- Gareth Patterson, the man who restored George Adamson's famed Kenya lion cubs to the wild in the Tuli Block of Botswana, will speak at the National Museum in Gaborone next week.
